title: A Fully Automated Multistage Deep Learning System for Lenke Classification: Enhanced Diagnostic Precision in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis.
summary: A multistage deep-learning pipeline automated Lenke classification for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis from clinical imaging and was compared with specialist labels.
organization: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

evidence.tested: The study reports improved agreement and precision against specialist reference labels; the reviewed evaluation does not establish prospective clinical outcome benefit.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning model enabled the stated case-specific result.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
